desc: This advanced weapon system comes equipped with a specialized targeting optic and airburst launcher. The Han X20 Skybreaker dials into a precise area within range and fires a 20mm airburst shell, which detonates in the air on target with devastating results. Highly effective at flushing cover. Direct impacts will result in a dud. Blocks Optic, Stock, and Barrel Attachments.

A top-loading, high-capacity M4 variant chambered in 5.7x28mm. Taking inspiration from other bullpup designs, this agile rifle is light, maneuverable, and boasts a higher rate of fire. Blocks Barrel and Magazine Attachments.

The Hyeon Hyperburst features an overlocked receiver that delivers a blinding-fast, three-round burst followed by slow, controlled, fully automatic fire. Deliver a burst of precision followed by sustained fire to finish off anything still standing.

Stun targets and clear tight quarters with shocking efficiency with the Patriot XMR Volt. This underbarrel launcher fires a wide dispersal of several 50,000V darts. Non-lethal, but powerful enough to override fine motor control and prime targets for elimination. Blocks Barrel Attachments.

An experimental disruption barrel with an integrated optic. Emits a concentrated high-intensity RF pulse capable of incapacitating infantry, crippling electronics, and destabilizing vehicles caught in its crosshairs.Blocks Barrel Attachments.

Turn devasting firepower into surgical precision. This conversion transforms the weapon into a semi-automatic sniper rifle, complete with a bipod, custom suppressor, and sniper scope to dominate distant targets with every shot. Blocks Barrel and Muzzle Attachments.

Built for fast-paced assaults, this conversion replaces the stock and pistol grip with a specialized chainsaw rear grip configuration. A handlebar foregrip, hip laser, and canted aiming system improve responsiveness for highly mobile, hipfire-focused gameplay. Blocks Optic, Laser, Underbarrel, Stock, and Rear Grip Attachments.

Fire a precision-guided missile and direct its flight path while aiming down sights using an infrared targeting laser. The projectile can be fired without guidance, though effectiveness drops sharply at extended ranges. Blocks Laser and Underbarrel Attachments.

Specialized RFD ammunition tags targets on impact, feeding real-time tracking data to the optic’s integrated display, which shows a red dot of the target’s movement and direction. Blocks Optic and Ammunition Attachments.

Built for lightning-fast weapon transitions, this tactical sling sacrifices the ability to equip stocks for unmatched reaction speed in close-quarters fights. Allows Quick Draw when used with Overkill. Blocks Stock Attachment.

A paired-frame conversion that outfits the Wz.55 Striga for akimbo use, doubling its close-quarters output while keeping the platform’s natural agility. Control takes discipline, but its speed and volume are unmatched. Blocks Optic, Stock, and Underbarrel Attachments.

A unique underbarrel that launches a rapid burst of advanced pyrotechnic projectiles, laying down intense incendiary coverage that remains burning for a short time, offering area control. Blocks Barrel, Underbarrel, and Magazine Attachments.

The pinnacle of stealth warfare, this subsonic modification produces an exceptionally quiet report, hides skills on enemy deaths, and minimizes direction hit indicators to keep your attacks concealed. Blocks Barrel and Ammunition Attachments.
Enables pump-action cycling and is outfitted with a side-saddle for hot-loaded explosive slugs. The added capability extends the platform’s engagement envelope well beyond tradition 12-gauge roles.
A blinding strobe pattern that triggers immediately upon aiming down sights and impairs hostile vision. The strobe must recharge between uses. Blocks Optic and Laser Attachments.

A Tempest Armament weapon modification that unthrottles the rate of fire beyond the weapon's operational abilities. Sustained fire can overheat the weapon requiring the weapon to cool down before returning to full auto fire.

A specialized weapon kit that adapts the Type 73 receiver to accept a top-mounted magazine loaded with Explosive Rounds. Limited ammo capacity is offset by the sheer, overwhelming stopping power. Blocks Magazine and Ammunition Attachments.
A high-grain ten-round belt replaces the box feed and locks the APOC-338 to semi-auto, trading sustained volume for a lighter profile and heavier impact on every round. Blocks Magazine Attachment.

Introducing the fully automatic MAR-9 Auto from Bruen. Boasting a high fire rate, this powerhouse provides a significant increase in stopping power over its semi-automatic counterpart. Blocks Trigger Action Attachment.

A compact blade module mounted to the receiver, housing up to three quick access throwing knives for close-range, low-signature engagements. Designed as a reliable fall back when stealth or conservation of fire matters most. Blocks Underbarrel Attachments.

For a bladed advantage, outfit the Mosin-Nagant with an advanced ballistic bayonet. In addition to improving melee lunge range, the spring-loaded bayonet can be launched at enemies and retrieved for repeat use. Blocks Barrel and Muzzle Attachments.
Allows for KG-9 Drillcharge rounds to be side-mounted to the rifle. Each projectile drills into a surface before quickly detonating. Ideal for flushing out entrenched combatants.

The Infiltrator combines sonar and radio wave pulses to detect enemies through cover and behind walls. The RF signal’s penetration is limited but offsets valuable recon in the right situation. Magazine capacity reduced to 1. Blocks Optic Attachments.

Give “weapons hot” a new meaning. This aftermarket modification from XRK loads the Signal 50 with .50 Cal Incendiary Rounds, providing a significant increase to vehicle and Killstreak damage. Blocks Ammunition Attachments.
An underbarrel shotgun attachment that loads one 12-gauge shell. Canted weapon stance braces against the 12-gauge recoil. Keep this handy for close encounters. Blocks Laser Attachments.
Held in an icepick grip, this CQB tactical knife is ready for action at a moment's notice. Improves melee damage and melee lunge range. Off-hand stabilizes the weapon for better recoil control.

Packaging devastating firepower and a thunderous rate of fire, this fully automatic .50 GS turns every trigger pull into a show of force. Warning: Not intended for accuracy. Blocks Trigger Action Attachments.
Fan the hammer to fire in quick succession from the hip, laying down rapid shots that favor speed over precision. Blocks Trigger Action Attachments.
